Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
Ok...I know that this is probably not the case, but just wanted to make sure
about the wording.

Coagulated Entity
Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control who belong to the same circle as
this acting vampire.
[san]: (D) Enter combat with a ready minion controlled by another
Methuselah. This acting vampire has +X strength and +X capacity. Before
combat begins, each chosen vampire must move 1 blood to the acting vampire
or this action is canceled.
[SAN]: As [san] above, and this vampire may prevent up to X damage this
combat.

It doesn't say that the +X strength and +X capacity is only for the duration
of the combat. The "prevent X damage" is followed by "this combat" making
it finite, but the other enhancements are not given this restriction. Are
they permanent?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
Neither is the combat.
The damage prevention is followed by "this combat" so as to prevent one from
thinking that it was just a one-shot use (prevent X damage from one effect).
